_noteP_appliesTo: APPLIES-TO CURATED (loop 476, user report that P attached anywhere). The trigger is onAbility because an ability CAST is what spawns the ring, but the damage is not dealt by the ability. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Akali, fetched 2026-08-20): after passing through the ring, Akali next BASIC ATTACK is empowered and deals the bonus magic damage. So it rides the attack, and appliesTo says AA even though the trigger reads onAbility - which is exactly the case the field exists for, since neither trigger default would land it in the right place.
_noteE_split: MULTI-CAST SPLIT (loop 471, user request). _noteE already recorded these as 'TWO casts, both real hits' - the throw (E1Damage, 30% of the full formula) and the recast dash (E2DamageCalc, 70%) - but holding them in one slot meant the editor always charged for both. Shuriken Flip's recast only happens if the shuriken hit, so it belongs in a sequence as its own node. binSpell E keeps the calc and rank resolution identical, and E + E2 sums to exactly the previous single-slot total.
